hmelphiplaza.name: Elbphilharmonie
hmelphiplaza.slogan: A glass wave on a brick warehouse, riding the Elbe.
hmelphiplaza.line: A marvel of clarity, precision and cool objectivity.
hmelphiplaza.by: Philip Kennicott on its acoustics, Washington Post

hmmichel.name: St. Michael's (Michel)
hmmichel.slogan: Hamburg's copper-green sailor's landmark, seen from every ship.
hmmichel.line: Its four clock faces are 8 metres across, the largest in Germany.

hvtreppenviertel.name: Blankenese Stairs
hvtreppenviertel.slogan: A fishing village stacked up the Elbe slope, stair by stair.

hvlangeanna.name: Lange Anna
hvlangeanna.slogan: Red sandstone standing alone in the North Sea.
hvlangeanna.line: The 47-metre red sandstone stack on Heligoland has been a natural monument since 1969.

hvfischmarkt.name: Fish Market
hvfischmarkt.slogan: Eels, bananas and brass bands before the city has slept.
hvfischmarkt.line: Altona's fish market has opened on Sunday mornings since 1703; its auction hall opened in 1896.
